verdict.rationale: Brex documents a token-authenticated REST API that can drive it without the UI. Admins create scoped user tokens in the dashboard and pass them in API headers, with transactions, budgets, expenses and payments APIs plus registrable webhooks. First-party guides cover scripted workflows such as bulk virtual-card creation via Pipedream, scheduled CSV exports via Zapier, and Workato recipes, but nothing addresses CI pipelines or headless runners directly. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or service-account/machine credentials (tokens are created manually in the dashboard), a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
